payload.goalOutcome:
Repair the existing Community Project Hub. The 9 files are staged in your workspace — read_file them first.

Defect: server.js route ordering. Line 110: `GET /api/projects/:id` matches any pathname starting with `/api/projects/` — including `/api/projects/1/tasks`. Line 118: `GET /api/projects/:id/tasks` is never reached because line 110 matches first. Result: `GET /api/projects/1/tasks` returns a project object instead of a tasks array.

Fix: reorder the routes so the more specific `/tasks` route is checked BEFORE the general `:id` route. OR add `&& !pathname.endsWith('/tasks')` to the line 110 condition. The fix is ONE route reorder or ONE condition addition.

Also fix test/integration.test.js: line 163 calls `startTestServer()` a second time on the same port (3002) while the first server from `test.before` is still running. This causes EADDRINUSE → "Server closed with code 1". Fix: store the server process from `test.before` and reuse it at line 163 instead of starting a new one. OR: stop the first server before starting the second.

Do NOT modify the other 7 files. Do NOT regenerate. Preserve all working features: SQLite persistence, project CRUD, task CRUD, input validation, the {ok,data,error} JSON shape, HTTP status codes, the node:sqlite DatabaseSync API, the vanilla frontend.

After repair, run `node --test test/api.test.js test/db.test.js test/integration.test.js` — ALL tests must pass.

After repair, call: {"action":"finish","summary":"repaired","artifacts":["server.js","public/index.html","public/styles.css","public/app.js","test/api.test.js","test/db.test.js","test/integration.test.js","package.json","README.md"]}
